Some of the best Sushi in town
Feb 2024 • Couples
Well haven’t tried them all as there is many Sushi places in Saigon. This was though one of the best and absolutely worth the money.
We had Sashimi and some rolls every single piece of food was delicious. Beer came in ice cold glass and as a first the waiter asked me if I wanted a second beer when she saw that I had almost finished the first. This doesn’t happen often here in town. 
So short if you want delicious Sushi and an ice cold beer and friendly staff then this is the perfect place to go.

I feel like I was ripped off and will not return
Apr 2023 • Solo
The food is not terrible, not outstanding. It's okay value for the price. The environment is what you are paying for and it's quite pleasant, as in the photos. Service is not bad but just feels like they are not naturally friendly people. Might be okay for a one-time break from the heat outside.

I was a semi regular lunch customer here until they suddenly stopped the VIP card points thing (which I think was buy ten meals and get one free). So without notice, the six stamps on my card are now worthless. They should have just allowed their customers to run through the cards and not issued new ones afterwards -- problem solved. If they had done that, I would have remained a customer and probably ranked the place at 3-4 stars.

However, I feel like I was ripped off and it's stupid to make your customers feel this way. I will never go there again.

Great Japanese cuisine with a good price
Aug 2019
Sushi World is nearby Sunwah Tower. I was brought her by a Vietnamese who lived in Japan. She explained that it was one of the best restaurants for sakae furai, my favorite Japanese dish. After my first visit, I came back many times with my friend.

Go for the set lunches. They are a very good price. It will fill you up especially if you get a side order of sushi. The waitress also let us switch dishes. I prefer miso soup so I got two instead of the gelatin chicken dish.

Customer service is great. If you need the restroom, it is upstairs in the back.

Akuruhi is right next door as well.

Overall, a good place for Japanese food.

An average place for sushi
Dec 2016 • Couples
We visited it on Christmas Eve randomly because the place we wanted to visit was full. The menu has great selection but it was similar to any other Japanese restaurant, nothing special. The price was not cheap. We had some sashimi, some rolls, an unagi rice bowl & grilled salmon. For the price, I would expect the unagi rice bowl would come with some kind of side dishes such as salad like other Jap restaurant but it was just the fish on the rice. And the unagi itself was kind of bland too. I would not visit it again because there are nicer restaurants in the area.
